title: Land Use and Land Cover Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques

novelty_points.claim: 将图像识别预训练卷积神经网络迁移到高分辨率RGB正射遥感影像的土地利用与覆盖分类，并结合适合地理空间数据的数据增强。
novelty_points.claim_en: Transfers image-recognition pretrained convolutional networks to land use and land cover classification of very-high-resolution RGB orthophotos, with geospatial data augmentation.
technical_features: 以可见光RGB高空间分辨率正射影像作为土地利用与覆盖分类输入。
将ImageNet任务学到的深度网络迁移到遥感分类，以减少对大规模遥感标注数据的依赖。
加入适合地理空间数据的数据增强，并在未见过的影像数据上检验泛化。
technical_features_en: Uses very-high-resolution orthorectified visible-band RGB imagery for land use and land cover classification.
Transfers deep networks trained on ImageNet to remote sensing classification without requiring massive labeled remote sensing datasets.
Applies geospatially suited dataset augmentation and evaluates generalization on unseen imagery.
